notes: SRv6 uses one-segment IPv6-in-IPv6 encapsulation and End.DT6 decapsulation in private endpoint namespaces; inner payload is 1388 bytes in 1518-byte tagged Ethernet frames.
Every run starts fresh namespaces and processes. No owned builds or tests overlap load.
Goodput excludes drain; loss, reordering and drop counters include drain. Daemon/thread CPU uses before/sent snapshots. Generator/receiver CPU covers each tool's lifetime, including receiver drain.
Report requested and offered rates separately: SRv6 generator CPU prevents the 21 Gbit/s request from being offered.
Socket/TAP counters count SKBs, not logical datagrams. SRv6 traffic arrives at TAP as ordinary frames in these tests.
inner is IPv4 UDP counters (relevant to plain controls); innerIpv6 is IPv6 counters (relevant to SRv6).
The ordinary tagged UDP overload control remains variable and below target; this change does not establish a plateau or the final throughput gates.
